The JET Li-BES system consists of 26 spatial channels along the neutral lithium beam, with a typical energy of ~55 keV.
The 26 line of sights are not perpendicular to the beam direction, causing Doppler shifts of the lithium beam emission.
The instrumental function and interference filter curve are modeled using non-parametric Gaussian processes.
The hyperparameters of the Gaussian processes, such as the overall scale and length scale, are determined by maximizing the evidence.
The likelihood function accounts for Poisson noise from photon statistics and electronic noise, which are modeled as Gaussian distributions.

The Bayesian approach allows the intensity of the Li line, Bremsstrahlung background, and instrumental offset to be inferred without the need for separate background measurements through beam modulation.
The Bayesian approach provides consistent estimates of the uncertainties associated with the extracted Li line intensity.
The reconstructed spectra from the Bayesian model agree well with the measured spectra.
For channel 16, the measured spectrum shows an extra peak due to impurity line radiation, which is not captured by the model.
The Li-BES system is used to infer edge electron density profiles based on the intensity of the Li I (2p-2s) line radiation.
The intensity profile of the Li line is subsequently used to reconstruct the electron density profile at the plasma edge.
The Gaussian process representation of the instrumental function and interference filter curve can be applied to improve spectral fitting for other systems.
The Bayesian approach allows the separation of signal and background without performing a separate background radiation measurement through a beam modulation procedure.
The usage of Gaussian processes to model instrumental effects can be applied generally to improve spectral fitting for other systems.
The proposed Bayesian modeling approach makes it possible to extract the intensity of the Li line without doing a separate background subtraction through modulation of the Li beam.
